label: Excellent
corporate_parent: Lauzon Distinctive Hardwood Flooring — independent, privately held. Papineauville, Québec, Canada.

finish_system.description: Titanium finish — UV-cured aluminum oxide. Pure Genius technology adds TiO2 photocatalyst that breaks down formaldehyde and VOCs in ambient air via light-activated reaction. Unique technology — genuinely differentiating.

milling_precision.description: Good milling precision — competitive with Mercier, slightly below Mirage. Third-strongest of the Québec cluster per installer consensus.

performance_evidence.air_purification: Pure Genius technology — TiO2 photocatalyst activated by natural or artificial light, breaks down formaldehyde, acetaldehyde, and other VOCs. Independent testing confirms measurable air quality improvement in controlled environment.

safety_evidence.formaldehyde: Greenguard Gold certified. Pure Genius technology actively reduces ambient formaldehyde.
safety_evidence.air_quality: Pure Genius air-purifying technology is genuinely differentiated — this is the only flooring that actively improves indoor air quality.
